text_block_list.text:
It's lunchtime, and the cafeteria is as<n>boisterous as
always.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Don't be stubborn, Hayahide! Have<n>my lunch! You
need it!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Ugh... I can't! That'll simply<n>compound the problem!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Hayahide's on a hunger strike, and<n>I'm worried
about her!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I'm not on a hunger strike! I simply<n>consumed a
large number of calories<n>earlier to optimize my brain
function in<n>class.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Unfortunately, I completed my<n>calculations far
sooner than expected,<n>and now my body is storing
an<n>excess of calories!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I get it! Well, if you want to get rid<n>of the extra
calories, then just do<n>some extra exercise!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
But that might result in overtraining. I<n>can't afford to
deviate from my<n>carefully balanced training
schedule.
choice_data_list: Don't worry. I can make some adjustments.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
It's my fault that I made a<n>miscalculation. It
wouldn't be fair to<n>burden you with more work
because<n>of my own mistake!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
You mean you don't want to ask your<n>trainer for
help? Why not? That's<n>exactly what trainers are
for!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Well, when you put it that way... Isuppose that is a trainer's job...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, as always. I don't know<n>what I'd do
without you.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I'm here for you too! We're friends,<n>after all! Now
have my lunch so you<n>can do your best out there!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...Were you listening to anything I just<n>said?

I make some adjustments to Biwa<n>Hayahide's
training schedule, and<n>she's able to account for the
extra<n>calories she consumed earlier.
